_comment: Salt-e PA settings template. Copy this to ~/.claude/settings.json, or merge just the 'hooks' block into your existing settings.json. Replace every <REPO_ROOT> with the ABSOLUTE path to your clone of this repo (Claude Code requires absolute paths in hook commands), for example /home/you/salt-e-pa or C:/Users/you/salt-e-pa. This template wires ONLY the two generic SessionStart hooks the scaffold ships and carries no permissions, env, statusLine, or plugin keys - add those yourself. See docs/automation.md for the walkthrough.
